attempted_claim: Fix E3(z)=2*pi*i*exp(z). Its singular value 0 satisfies E3(0)=2*pi*i and E3(2*pi*i)=2*pi*i, so 0 is strictly preperiodic to the repelling fixed point 2*pi*i of multiplier 2*pi*i; hence E3 is Misiurewicz with finite bounded postsingular set {0, 2*pi*i} and Julia set C. Let c=(c_n)_{n>=1} over {0,1} be the Thue-Morse address defined by c_n=parity of the binary digit-sum of n-1, which is bounded, uniformly recurrent, cube-free and not eventually periodic. Let g_c be its Schleicher-Zimmer dynamic ray. Decide with proof which holds: (i) g_c lands at a finite repelling preperiodic point and state its preperiod and period; or (ii) g_c does not land and its accumulation set is a nondegenerate continuum of Devaney-Jarque indecomposable type. A complete answer proves exactly one of (i),(ii) for this fixed verified Misiurewicz map and automatic address, testing automatic versus preperiodic portrait rigidity.
decisive_failure: No verified landing-implies-preperiodic rigidity theorem with matching strip conventions was available in-session, so Thue-Morse non-eventual-periodicity could not be converted into a landing exclusion; no nonlanding witness or indecomposability argument for the bounded address was found; high-precision numerics diagnose only generic pullback contraction with postsingular collapse and decide nothing about the true ray.
